statsd_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the StatsD server to send metrics to.

statsd_port.description: UDP port on which StatsD listens (commonly 8125).

statsd_prefix.description: Optional prefix for all metric names (e.g., 'proftpd.prod' for namespace separation).

statsd_transport.description: Transport protocol to use for sending metrics: 'udp' (faster, lossy) or 'tcp' (reliable).

statsd_flush_interval.description: Interval (in milliseconds) between metric flushes to StatsD. Set to override default (1000 ms).

statsd_debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging for the module (logs metric payloads to ProFTPD log).

enabled_metrics.description: List of metric types to emit. Choose from: session.count, session.duration, session.bytes_sent, session.bytes_recv, auth.success, auth.failure, cmd.count.

statsd_tags.description: Static key-value tags to attach to every metric (e.g., environment=prod, service=ftp).

histogram_buckets.description: Histogram bucket boundaries (in seconds) for timing-based metrics like session.duration. Values must be positive numbers.

items.description: Upper boundary (in seconds) for a histogram bucket.
